data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- dd-1: calibration-report.sh mutation-append posts a single entry to mutation-history for a given PR's mutation findings
- dd-5: Running mutation-append twice for the same PR identifier produces exactly one entry (idempotency guard)

Add the mutation-append subcommand to plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh:

  calibration-report.sh mutation-append --pr=<pr-number> --findings-file=<json-path>

The subcommand:
1. Reads mutation findings from --findings-file (JSON) 
2. Checks the mutation-history tracking ticket for an existing entry with the same PR number (idempotency check using an HTML comment marker <!-- calibration-rollup: pr=<N> kind=mutation --> similar to the monthly marker)
3. If entry exists: exits 0 without posting duplicate
4. If no entry: posts a single comment to the mutation-history tracking ticket via .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <mutation-history-id>
5. Uses the DSO env-var override pattern for testability: DSO="${DSO:-$SCRIPT_DIR/dso}"

Create tests/scripts/test-calibration-mutation-append.sh covering:
- First invocation posts one entry
- Second invocation with same PR is a no-op (idempotency)
- --dry-run flag skips posting and exits 0

## Testing Mode
RED — write the test first; it fails because mutation-append subcommand does not exist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- calibration-report.sh mutation-append exists — Verify: grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*mutation-append\)' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- Idempotency test passes — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-mutation-append.sh
- Test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-calibration-mutation-append.sh
- DSO env-var override present — Verify: grep -qE 'DSO.*DSO.*dso' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh — Edit
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-mutation-append.sh — Create
data.title: Add mutation-append subcommand to calibration-report.sh with idempotency guard
